text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kenyan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition members of parliament boycott for second day debate on 1997/98 budget.
- President Moi says government will take action against anyone using forthcoming elections as excuse for violence.
- National Council of Churches of Kenya denounces opposition for boycotting parliament.
- Registration of voters in Bungoma town, western Kenya, is poor because some people demand money from prospective candidates.
- Officials from ruling party in Nyanza province accuse opposition of using constitutional reforms issue as campaign gimmick to woo votes for forthcoming elections.
